en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Hamza, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Bestow upon me<sup>asws</sup> with the reliance upon You<sup>azwj</sup>, and the delegation to You<sup>azwj</sup> (of the affairs), and the pleasure with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Ordainment, and the submission to Your<sup>azwj</sup> Command, until I<sup>asws</sup> do not love the hastening of whatever You<sup>azwj</sup> Delay, nor the delay of what You<sup>azwj</sup> Hasten, O Lord<sup>azwj</sup> of the worlds’’.
en.sarwar: 14. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn Mahbub from abu Hamza from Ali ibn al- Husayn (a.s.) who has said the following: “

Amir al-Mu’minin, Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.) would say, ‘O Lord, oblige me with the ability to place my trust in You and leave my affairs in Your hands, agree with Your measures, submit to Your command so that I do not love the hastening of what You have delayed or the delay of what You have hastened, O Lord of the worlds.’”
